handoffs.message: Memory Layer Design Note ready for review. Artifacts: services/memory/MEMORY_LAYER_DESIGN_NOTE.md, services/memory/persona_memory.schema.json, services/memory/institutional_memory_entry.schema.json. Closes GAP-04. All 4 acceptance criteria met: 2 object schemas, write-back pipeline, retrieval query path, postmortem→institutional memory→research reuse example.

Review found 2 required fixes: align InstitutionalMemory source_event_type with the consultation write-back trigger, and make the retrieval example include required session_id. See services/memory/review_bg004_codex.md.

Both Codex review findings fixed: (1) added consultation_closed to institutional_memory source_event_type enum; (2) added required session_id to worked retrieval example. JSON schemas validated. Ready for re-review.

Re-review complete: MEMORY_LAYER_DESIGN_NOTE and both memory schemas are aligned. consultation_closed is present in InstitutionalMemoryEntry.source_event_type, the worked retrieval example includes required session_id, and both schema files parse successfully. Approving for Qwen final closure.
